readings.summary: Decorate every generated type—including formatters, string-key formatters, enum/union formatters, and resolvers—with ExcludeFromCodeCoverage unconditionally and provide no setting.
readings.code_difference: Update all relevant source-generator transforms so every emitted generated type receives the attribute, conditionally emitting it only as needed for target-framework compatibility, and update all affected verified snapshots; unlike the narrower reading, resolver and other non-formatter generated types are included, and unlike the opt-out reading no configuration API is added.

readings.summary: Apply ExcludeFromCodeCoverage unconditionally only to generated formatter types, leaving non-formatter generated code such as resolvers without the attribute.
readings.code_difference: Change the formatter-related transforms and their snapshots but not resolver or other generated-type templates; the emitted coverage behavior and scope of modified snapshots differ from the all-generated-types reading.

readings.summary: Decorate all generated types with ExcludeFromCodeCoverage by default, but add an optional generator setting that lets users opt out.
readings.code_difference: Implement the same default emission across all generated types as the first reading while also adding and documenting a public/MSBuild generator option, threading it through generation, suppressing the attribute when disabled, and covering that behavior with snapshots or tests.

output.quote: Ambiguity driver: scope (all generated types vs formatters only) and setting (unconditional vs opt-out) are both open.
